# Tables and captions {#tables}

The GFM separator row mixed the choice of header row with column alignment. In 0.2 every pipe row is a row of cells: header cells start with `|=`, and alignment sits on the cell as `|={<}`, `|={~}` or `|={>}` ([#5091](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/issues/5091), C2-B-171, C2-B-182). A caption line must stand directly below its table or image (C2-B-146).

**U-055** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> GFM separator row

::: compare no-render
```text
| a | b |
|---|--:|
| 1 | 2 |
```
```crv
|= a |={>} b |
| 1 | 2 |
```
:::

**U-271** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-230, a header row inside a body, `{body-rows=1 body-header-rows=1}` above `\| a \|` and `\| b \|`, wrote `<th scope="col">a</th>` in 0.1; and with `body-rows` a pipe table had no head unless `header-rows` gave one.
Tool: Review the scope; write a head with header marks in place of `header-rows` (U-058).

::: compare no-render
```text
{body-rows=1 body-header-rows=1}
| a |
| b |
```
```text
<table>
  <tbody>
    <tr><th scope="row">a</th></tr>
    <tr><td>b</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table> C2-B-230, C2-H-056: a header row inside a body holds header cells, which take `scope="row"` as every header cell outside the head; 0.1 wrote `scope="col"`. A pipe table with `body-rows` keeps the head its header marks give (C2-B-178), where 0.1 made no head; write the head with header marks in place of `header-rows` (U-058).
```
:::

**U-279** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-146 and C2-I-002, the indent of a continuation line of a caption, `\|x\|`, `^ a`, `  - b`; and a tab behind the space of the caption mark, `^ `, a tab, `second`
Tool: The caption text starts at its first character that is not a space or a tab, on each line: `- b`, `second`. Escaped spaces give no-break spaces and a tab has no escape, so no spelling keeps the 0.1 text.

::: compare no-render
```text
|x|
^ a
  - b
```
```text
<table>
  <caption>a
- b</caption>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>x</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table> C2-B-146 and C2-I-002 drop the indent of a continuation line of a caption and the spaces and tabs behind the caption mark's spaces; 0.1 kept both in the caption text. Escaped spaces give no-break spaces, not the 0.1 text, and a tab has no escape.
```
:::

:::
